doc.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023

chapter: Career, recognition and jazz in America
title: Churchill, cigars and the Dizzy Gillespie t-shirt
summary: A light exchange about admiring Churchill, smoking cigars since age 14, and the Dizzy shirt he wears.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: He was. I love reading about him.
Great personality, very smart, very eloquent, and a guy with great ideas. He was a gentleman. And also, he smoked cigars like me too.
Can I call you a cigar aficionado?
Yeah that’s a first for us.
I started smoking cigars 60 years ago, when I was 14 years old.
Every freaking day. My hero, Dizzy Gillespie, also smoked cigars.
Thank you for wearing that tee shirt by the way.
Oh I love it, man. A good friend of mine took a photo that I have here in my studio, I can show you, I’ve got a photo here, exactly this photo, and he took a photo of that and from
that made a couple of these for me. And I’m so happy to wear it you know. Because that guy meant a lot to me.
